scope: Targeted NFS mount contract; not all storage types, fields or page coverage
command_note: Requires the private NFS/remote-agent fixture described in test/e2e/RUNNING.md; --config points at that machine-specific JSON. Not runnable without it.

cases.name: 存储 / UI 指定真实节点试挂载并创建 NFS / 刷新 ready、双向文件校验且删除后真实卸载

requirements: Explicit authenticated remote instance and online real agent with accessible host terminal
Existing enabled NFS storage ready and writable on exactly the configured fixture node
Agent host root privilege, NFS mount helper and NFS server permitting subdirectory mounting
Dedicated runId source subdirectory and absent /mnt/gpuworks-e2e/<runId> target
Host inspection reads the same mount namespace as the agent
environment.selection: Only the explicitly configured node; existing storage definition is read-only fixture input

crud.Create: UI trial mount then UI create with exact chosen-node request
crud.Read: Independent API GET and refreshed nodes tab agree with live agent status
crud.Update: MISSING: NFS edit and enabled-state runtime changes are separate contracts
crud.Delete: UI deletion, API 404, actual agent unmount and retained source bytes before fixture cleanup

covered: owned NFS subdirectory exact value and mountinfo source
explicit new mount point and actual kernel mount
omitted request; kernel effective options in trial evidence

checklist_items.1.7: UI NFS create after real trial mount
checklist_items.1.14: Independent persistence, observed agent readiness and kernel/filesystem evidence
checklist_items.4.3: Exact export and mount point in UI request, saved definition and kernel mountinfo
checklist_items.6: PARTIAL: exact real node selection; full selector matrix remains missing
checklist_items.12: PARTIAL: named create/delete dialogs and current-viewport footer

proof: Trial mount reports real NFS version/options, read/write and capacity, then leaves no temporary mount of this export
Saved resource reports only the selected node ready with the exact mount point
Kernel mountinfo maps that mount point to the owned export with NFS filesystem type
Source marker read through new mount matches SHA256
File written and fsynced through new mount is read through source share with matching SHA256
UI delete causes agent-owned mount to disappear while source files remain intact
limits: One real agent; no cross-host coherence or NFS performance claim
No deployment or container consumes the new storage
No NFS cache, failover or mount recovery claim

cases.cleanup: Remove only owned storage and runId directories after observed unmount; retain owned inventory and failure evidence on error; verify existing source definition unchanged
